fixtures.title: Exact positive Alias-to-snapshot-to-trusted-binding identity
fixtures.input: One selected Skill declares Alias ca -> stable package ID P; one ResolvedDependency has dependencyId ca and a digest equal to the recomputed original-byte digest; exactly one TrustedDependencyBinding matches (ca,digest) and carries stablePackageId P.
assertions: WP3A emits no dependency identity error or warning.
The resolved identity tuple is exactly (ca, measuredDigest, P).
Reordering source files, snapshot files, ResolvedDependencies and DependencyBindings does not change the result.
Later unimplemented compiler stages still fail closed; Build is not expected to succeed.

fixtures.title: Contract package ID differs from trusted package ID
fixtures.input: Use the Appendix E.1-E.4 success baseline and change only Contract.dependencies.ca to a different valid Stable Package ID; recompute the snapshot digest and retain a trusted binding for the original package.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_ID_MISMATCH/C_STATIC.
The diagnostic is attached to the Contract dependency value node.
No filename, package display name or URI-prefix fallback is attempted.

fixtures.title: Trusted dependency identity binding is missing
fixtures.input: Use the Appendix E.1-E.4 success baseline and remove the TrustedDependencyBinding for Alias ca while retaining the exact immutable snapshot.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED/C_STATIC.
The diagnostic is attributed to trusted BuildRequest metadata (empty path, line 0, column 0).
No identity is inferred from ToolCatalog metadata or the snapshot contents.

fixtures.title: Trusted binding refers to a different measured snapshot digest
fixtures.input: Use the Appendix E.1-E.4 success baseline and retain a binding for Alias ca whose digest differs from the digest recomputed from the supplied snapshot bytes.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED/C_STATIC.
The compiler matches both dependencyId and measured digest; matching dependencyId alone is insufficient.

fixtures.title: A used Contract Alias has no supplied snapshot
fixtures.input: Use a selected Skill that references declared Alias ca from an operation.tool or external Schema reference, but omit the ResolvedDependency whose dependencyId is ca.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_SNAPSHOT_MISSING/C_STATIC.
Do not replace it with EXPORT_ID_MISSING or SCHEMA_MISSING.

fixtures.title: Multiple snapshots or trusted bindings ambiguously match one Alias
fixtures.input: Provide two ResolvedDependency entries for the same used dependencyId, or two trusted bindings for the same exact (dependencyId, measuredDigest) identity.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_DUPLICATE/C_STATIC.
Do not select the first matching item or depend on input order.

fixtures.title: Contract dependency value is not a Stable Package ID string
fixtures.input: Change Contract.dependencies.ca from a valid absolute Stable Package ID string to a mapping, sequence or invalid URI value.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_REQUIREMENT_INVALID/C_STATIC.
The diagnostic retains the original Contract YAML key/value source location.

fixtures.title: A supported external reference uses an undeclared Alias
fixtures.input: Use a syntactically valid Alias::ExportId or Alias::absolute-Schema-ID reference whose Alias is absent from Contract.dependencies.
assertions: The primary diagnostic is DEPENDENCY_ALIAS_MISSING/C_STATIC.
Only frozen source positions are scanned; arbitrary strings containing :: are ignored.

fixtures.title: Unreferenced extra snapshot cannot become a global export
fixtures.input: Use a valid selected Skill and its used dependency snapshots, then add one extra valid ResolvedDependency that no selected Skill declares or references.
assertions: The extra snapshot is not included in the selected Skill dependency closure.
The extra snapshot is not parsed, indexed or exposed as a source of callable/Schema exports in WP3A.
The extra snapshot does not create an error solely because it is outside the selected Skill dependency closure.
Request-level raw-byte integrity and resource limits still apply to every supplied snapshot.

fixtures.title: Declared but unused Contract dependency is a warning
fixtures.input: Declare a valid dependency Alias in Contract.dependencies but do not reference it from any supported source position in the selected Skill.
assertions: The diagnostic severity is warning and phase is C_WARNING.
The warning does not independently block Build.
The unused Alias does not enter the selected dependency closure.
